name: F3/F4 assessed structured QA proof shared by completion and receipts

files_modify.purpose: Shared structured QA validator, typed candidate binding and both receipt prerequisite consumers.
Direct completion consumer, begin-pinned check inventory and candidate-aware route eligibility.
Migrate passing QA fixtures to executed captures and direct completion adversarial coverage.
Migrate receipt fixtures to executed captures and identical prerequisite adversarial coverage.
Versioned structured QA proof interface while retaining historical readable forms.
Optional typed verification check fields for future governed completion.
Optional typed verification inventory required by runtime for future completion.
Optional typed verification inventory required by runtime for future completion.
Document proof producer workflow, candidate types and legacy refusal behavior.

non_goals: Installed .nizam edits; run_state lifecycle ownership; remote publication, merge, release or deployment.
Replacing receipt own-command checks; trusting aggregate flags or synthesizing upgraded proof from legacy metadata.
CL empty-blob repair, fifth exploit claims, cryptographic authenticity of untrusted local execution producers.

acceptance_requirements.requirement: One validate_qa_proof(root, verdict, *, feature_id, candidate, required_checks) implementation raises AssuranceError on invalid proof and returns validated proof on success; direct completion plus route-qa and fresh-qa receipt prerequisites use it. Existing receipt command proof checks remain intact.

New proof_version:2 QA records carry candidate_ref={path,sha256} (optional revision for committed artifact resolver) pointing to a complete existing assessed-input identity, checks=[{id,capture:{path,sha256[,revision]}}]. Required inventory entries are {id,argv,expected_exit,proof_kind,diagnostic}; argv is a nonempty string array, expected_exit integer, proof_kind success or semantic-negative, diagnostic string or null. Inventory IDs are unique. All declared checks match the inventory exactly, without omissions, duplicates or extras. Existing favorable aggregate fields cannot override failed proof.

For nonfeature tasks verification inventory lives in scope/intent and is canonicalized and bound in begin task base; absent/altered inventory refuses new completion. Feature required checks come from approved candidate-bound contract verification, with explicit typed fields; historical shell command may normalize to argv only when unambiguous and identical. No invented inventory from QA itself. Legacy bases/inventories lacking needed proof require fresh begin/capture.

Resolve and validate manifest identity using existing validate_identity/_receipt_candidate, including canonical digest, exact repository/source tree/material inputs/environment/ownership. Candidate_ref digest is a file byte digest; capture candidate_sha256 remains existing sha(canonical(candidate)) binding. Reject unresolved/bare 40-hex commit and arbitrary 64-hex digest as sufficient new completion proof. Enforce expected candidate equality in receipts; direct completion loads candidate manifest and validates current assessed inputs. Candidate includes authorization inventory and verifier material inputs. Route eligibility must inspect supplied candidate and prove intent/contract scope matches bound assessed input.

Resolve every structured capture by digest and parse it, normalize existing raw captures and closed published receipt captures, compare exact argv/candidate/environment/revision/executed/completion/outcome/exit against independent inventory. Validate actual stdout/stderr references and bytes. Raw live refs are checked at current path and SHA256; revisioned refs use existing committed artifact checks plus live identity where required. Missing, malformed, tampered, stale or contradictory proof refuses.

success requires expected_exit=0 and observed successful outcome. semantic-negative may match pinned nonzero exit plus required diagnostic line with raw outcome failed, or an exit-zero semantic-negative evaluator wrapper asserting its child predicate; never reinterpret an ordinary failed capture as success. Zero-byte stdout/stderr is valid when referenced digest matches. Negative expected outcome/diagnostic must both match.

Historical QA formats remain schema-readable. They can support a future transition only if all required structured proof, independent inventory and manifest bindings validate equivalently; metadata-only/plaintext/aggregate-only forms refuse with fresh-execution guidance. Non-Git historical display/local records remain readable but cannot claim assessed governed completion.

Run same accept/reject matrix for direct completion and both receipt prerequisites: failed-capture contradictions; missing per-check evidence/check inventory; wrong candidate/command/material input; stream tampering; reused proof; aggregate pass with failed check. Positive cases include real success, raw semantic-negative, successful negative wrapper, empty streams, unchanged F1/F2 behavior and valid receipt replay.

evidence_convention: Exclusive role/check/attempt captures with raw stdout/stderr; retain all failed attempts.
authority_note: Fresh proposed design; no prior F1/F2 approval is imported. Requires independent pre-code reviews before implementation.
